summary: 7 currently actionable high-value roles after manual eligibility, compensation, freshness, and sponsorship-risk review. Zettabyte New Grad was explicitly vetoed for no visa sponsorship; internship/contract and senior-only false positives were excluded.

recommendations.new_grad: General full-time SWE; suitable for new grads
recommendations.reason: Exceptional compensation and strong fit for competitive programming, C++/Python, systems thinking, and performance-oriented engineering. Jane Street explicitly considers candidates across software, ML, systems administration, and PL backgrounds.
recommendations.caveat: Posting is not labeled 2027 New Grad, so campus-cycle timing is less explicit than IMC/Citadel; sponsorship is not stated on the posting.
recommendations.application_limit: Jane Street states one application can be considered across available positions/offices; avoid redundant applications.

recommendations.new_grad: Early Career; <=3 years post-education professional experience
recommendations.reason: Direct match to Python/C++, distributed systems, quantitative strength, and performance-minded systems work. The role rotates across technology teams supporting research/trading and is one of the strongest non-PhD matches.
recommendations.caveat: Sponsorship is not stated; verify in application/recruiter flow before investing heavily in interview prep.
recommendations.application_limit: Prefer Early Career over the experienced C++/Systems postings; the Systems Engineer role requires 10+ years and is a hard reject.

recommendations.role: Large Language Model Inference System Engineer Graduate (Applied Machine Learning) - 2027 Start
recommendations.reason: Near-direct match to vLLM/model-loading optimization, LLM inference, distributed systems, C++/Python, CUDA, and systems research. This is one of the highest technical-fit roles in the current dataset.
recommendations.caveat: ByteDance/TikTok applications are limited per recruiting cycle; choose this over weaker generic backend/testing roles.
recommendations.application_limit: Counts toward ByteDance/TikTok cycle limits; prioritize only the top 1-2 roles.

recommendations.role: Large Language Model Training System Engineer Graduate (Applied Machine Learning) - 2027 Start
recommendations.urgency: High fit; only if application cap allows
recommendations.reason: Excellent match to AutoScout, distributed training configuration, NCCL/parallelism, Python/C++/Rust, networking, and ML systems research.
recommendations.caveat: Do not let ByteDance dominate the application portfolio; this is the second and final ByteDance/TikTok recommendation today.
recommendations.application_limit: Counts toward ByteDance/TikTok cycle limits; compare carefully with the inference-system role before submitting.

recommendations.reason: Strong startup quality and compensation with explicit Summer 2027 eligibility. Less ML-systems-heavy than top picks, but attractive as a high-upside AI-native general SWE role with Golang/AWS exposure.
recommendations.caveat: More product/full-stack than GPU/LLM runtime infrastructure; sponsorship is not stated.
recommendations.application_limit: No special company cap identified; lower opportunity cost than capped firms.

recommendations.reason: Relevant to TikTok AI-evaluation workflow experience plus production AI systems: multimodal agents, LLM workflows, evaluation, performance, cloud infrastructure, monitoring, and end-to-end ownership.
recommendations.caveat: FDE/customer-facing work is less aligned with low-level ML systems than inference/training roles, and compensation/sponsorship are not stated.
recommendations.application_limit: Prefer this 2026-2027 FDE role over Netic postings that are internships or require Summer 2026-or-earlier starts.

recommendations.role: 2027 Blackstone Technology and Innovations - Software Engineer Analyst
recommendations.reason: Elite-brand general SWE option with explicit 2027 cycle and compensation above the hard floor. Worth keeping as a diversified fallback after higher-fit AI/quant systems applications.
recommendations.caveat: Much weaker technical fit and upside than ML systems / quant SWE priorities; do not spend a scarce tailored-resume slot here.
recommendations.application_limit: Use generic SWE resume; preserve customization effort for higher-fit roles.

vetoed_today.reason: Explicitly requires U.S. work authorization without visa sponsorship; hard veto despite excellent AI-infrastructure fit.
Requires 10+ years of professional systems/infrastructure experience; hard seniority reject.
